title: ¿Qué es una nación?
goal: Read why a nation isn't the same thing as a state or a territory, through the idea of 'imagined communities' — and why most members of any nation will never meet.

items: Distinguish between territory, state and nation.
Explain Benedict Anderson's concept of 'imagined communities'.
Explain what challenge this posed for new 19th-century republics.
Explain why building a nation required deliberate decisions, not just time.
Use ser, consistir en and relative clauses to define abstract concepts precisely.
